This is the tidyverse practice with the plant height data.

```{r}
#add tidyverse and make the csv file
library(tidyverse)
plantdata <- read_csv("plantdata.csv")
```

```{r}
#take data from 27th only
plantdata <- plantdata |> filter(survey_date == "2023-01-27")
```

```{r}
plantdata |>
  group_by(pop) |>
  summarize(avg_height = mean(height_cm))
```
